A four-[[breast]]ed '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[humanoid]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="SC 102" /> Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="SCDate">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> a [[Color|light]]-skinned, dark-[[hair]]ed<ref name="SC 102" /> [[Gender|female]]<ref name="SC 102 AD">{{SkeletonCrew|Way, Way Out Past the Barrier}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> [[Unidentified door girl|member]] of the species was present at [[Borgo Prime|Starport Borgo]], performing solo dances<ref name="SC 102" /> as a [[door girl]]<ref name="SC 102 AD" /> to attract customers to a [[Unidentified dance club|local dance club]].<ref name="SC 102" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[species]] first appeared in "[[Way, Way Out Past the Barrier]]," the second episode of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'',<ref name="SC 102" /> which premiered on [[December 2]], [[2024]].<ref name="Premiere">{{Twitter|StarWars|status/1861409832349172011|[[Star Wars]]|quote=Mark your calendars. 🗓️ On December 2, stream the two-episode series premiere of #SkeletonCrew, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/QwMYe}}</ref>
